description: This pie chart illustrates the domain distribution of the AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which comprises 12 distinct domains, each represented by a colored slice with its corresponding percentage labeled. The largest segment is “AI/NLP Research” at 24.3%, shown in blue. The second largest is “Econ. & Fin.” at 18.4%, depicted in teal. Other notable segments include “History” at 8.2% (yellow), “Game&Anime” at 8.2% (orange), “Law” at 5.1% (pink), “Science” at 6.7% (light blue), “Med & Health” at 6.7% (green), “Pet & Animal” at 5.5% (orange), “Daily Life” at 7.1% (light blue), “Business” at 5.9% (red), and “Geography” at 2.7% (yellow-green), with “Math” at 1.2% (dark green) being the smallest. The chart includes a legend that links each domain to its color and percentage, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest segment positioned at the top right.
